name: claude-task-master
setup: . scripts/env.sh && mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" "$ENV/puppeteer" && cd "$SRC" && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules dist && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/puppeteer" PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" "$ENV/puppeteer" "$ENV/.svn" && export HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/puppeteer" PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm_config_cache="$RM/.tools/npm-cache" && unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY OPENAI_API_KEY PERPLEXITY_API_KEY GOOGLE_API_KEY && npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && NODE_ENV=test CI=true node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --ci --no-cache --forceExit
typecheck_cmd: export HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/puppeteer" PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 TURBO_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 && ./node_modules/.bin/turbo typecheck --cache-dir="$ENV/turbo-cache" --force
notes: Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0 (CI uses Node 20, .nvmrc 22; Node 24 works). npm workspaces monorepo (root task-master-ai + apps/* + packages/*), installed with `npm ci` from package-lock.json (2459 packages, ~20s). Browser downloads disabled everywhere (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD/PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$ENV/puppeteer/PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD): puppeteer is only a transitive dep of apps/docs (@mintlify/scraping); no test uses a browser. HOME/TMPDIR are sandboxed into $ENV for setup and tests; after the final runs nothing new appeared in ~/.cache or ~/.npm. test_cmd mirrors CI's Test job: `npm run build` (build-config + tsdown -> dist/, ~2s, needed because integration tests exec dist/task-master.js), then root jest (`node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest`, tests/ only) with NODE_ENV=test CI=true, without CI's --coverage. --no-cache is required: with a warm jest transform cache, ~40 ESM suites fail with "Export '__signal_exit_emitter__' is not defined" (cache-dependent flake); a cold cache gives the stable result. $ENV/.svn is created as a project-boundary marker: TMPDIR lives under the router-migrate root (a git repo), and task-master's findProjectRoot walks up from temp dirs. Without the marker, `rules add` in hamster-rules-distribution wrote .cursor/.roo/.kiro/... profile files into the router-migrate root (I removed those). With it, they land in $ENV instead. Baseline: 1522 passed, 9 failed, 25 skipped, 0 errors (133/135 suites pass). Both runs gave the same counts. All 9 failures come from TMPDIR being under a marked directory, not from LLM code: tests/unit/task-master.test.js 'should return cwd when no project markers found' (1), and tests/integration/profiles/hamster-rules-distribution.test.js 'receives hamster rules via rules add --mode=team' (8 profiles), because the walk finds $ENV/.svn instead of falling back to cwd. Offline: both runs were under macOS sandbox-exec with outbound network denied (loopback allowed). The AI provider tests mock 'ai' and the provider SDKs; no API keys are set (ANTHROPIC/OPENAI/PERPLEXITY/GOOGLE keys and RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY are unset). Nothing deselected. typecheck_cmd = CI's `turbo typecheck` (9 tasks across workspace packages; its build deps run first), with telemetry off and a turbo cache in $ENV forced cold: exit 0, 0 errors. Root JS (src/ai-providers, scripts/) has no typecheck script, so turbo does not cover it. The alternative `tsc --noEmit -p .` at the root gives 643 pre-existing errors, mostly TS6142 jsx in apps/extension, so I did not use it.
